title: telemetry-habit-tracker-and-stacked-triage-templates
author: Maya Patel
description:
Add a lightweight telemetry habit tracker and a stacked triage template mechanism to incident-bot. Motivation: on-call responders frequently run the same small set of diagnostic queries during triage; tracking aggregate usage (without payload contents) enables the product to suggest a minimal, high-signal checklist in the incident card and to propose stacked templates when an alert fingerprint matches multiple likely causes. This PR implements: 1) habit tracker: instrumented counters for anonymized diagnostic commands (query IDs only), a small in-process windowed aggregator, and an optional backend ingestion hook for rollup export. 2) stacked triage templates: allow multiple short templates to be attached to an alert fingerprint with ordering and conditional hints; the Slack card UI will show the top 2 templates with an inline expand for the rest. 3) privacy and sampling: default 1% sampling of full diagnostic payloads, redaction rules applied to sensitive fields before any export, and an opt-out knob per-org. 4) rollout/migration: migration script to bake existing templates into the stacked format and a console feature flag to enable the new UI. The description includes testing notes, rollout plan, and performance regressions measured in staging. Checklist:
- [x] implement habit tracker and aggregator
- [x] add stacked template schema and CLI management commands
- [x] instrument Slack card UI for stacked templates
- [x] add redaction+sampling hooks and privacy docs
- [x] migration script and Linear link for rollout
- [x] unit and integration tests

Testing and validation: unit tests for the aggregator and template merging logic; an integration scenario in the staging workspace that exercised the Slack card UI at scale (1000 synthetic alerts) to validate card rendering perf. Perf notes: habit tracking adds ~0.3ms median to handler path with batching; aggregator runs on a dedicated background worker to avoid tail latencies. Security/privacy: redaction policy and sampling implementation reviewed with security; payloads exported to the backend are tagged with no-identifiers and per-org opt-out honored. Rollout: behind feature flag 'telemetry_habit_stack_v1' with gradual ramp: 1% -> 10% -> 100% over 3 days after canary validation. Related: ENG-7621 for UX acceptance criteria, PM-342 for rollout coordination, SUP-1982 for a customer request to export commonly-run diagnostics.

release_notes:
- Added telemetry habit tracker to surface commonly-run diagnostic commands and suggest targeted checklists.
- Introduced stacked triage templates: attach multiple short templates to an alert fingerprint with prioritized suggestion in Slack cards.
- Privacy: default sampling and redaction rules with per-org opt-out.
- Rollout behind feature flag 'telemetry_habit_stack_v1' with gradual ramp plan.
notes_for_releasers: Enable feature flag in staging and validate Slack card UX with oncall team; monitor habit tracker metrics for skew and ensure exclusion lists capture noisy automation. Migration script included: run once per org during rollout window.
